filedItems.item: GA custom lists (maintenance, payments, caisse, team, approbations) have no pagination while upstream lists paginate
filedItems.reason: They fetch bounded per-agency datasets in full and render all rows — a deliberate GA design (client-side live filters, summary cards computed over the full set). Adding pagination is a feature change, not a one-pattern alignment; volumes are small in practice (1 expense, 0 payments, a handful of journal rows in the verified data).

filedItems.item: Search shape differs by family: shared <Search> submits on button/Enter (upstream lists) while GA lists filter live onChange; team/approbations/notifications have no keyword search at all
filedItems.reason: Each family is internally consistent; team/approbations lists are small and already carry their context selector (agency). Unifying submit semantics across families = redesign of the shared Search contract, out of A4's minimal-fix scope.

filedItems.item: DataGrid sorting is client-side over the loaded page while pagination is server-side (bookings, users, clients)
filedItems.reason: Identical on both DataGrid screens (consistent siblings); making it server-side needs backend sort parameters — new feature work. Noted so the owner knows a column sort reorders only the current page.

filedItems.item: DataGrid footer chrome ('Rows per page:', '1–10 of 10') stays in English in fr/ar
filedItems.reason: MUI DataGrid localeText is only overridden for noRowsLabel in both grids; full MUI locale packs (frFR/arSD) would fix it but change shared grid configuration for a cosmetic string — filed for an owner call.

filedItems.item: No formatter pins timeZone Africa/Casablanca; all screens render browser-local time
filedItems.reason: Uniform across every screen (verified browser = Africa/Casablanca, so output is Casablanca today). Pinning everywhere incl. upstream + scheduler library is a cross-cutting change, not a one-pattern fix; risk of shifting displayed times for any non-Casablanca browser is an owner decision.

filedItems.item: Dashboard upcoming-booking dates omit the year (day, month, hour, minute)
filedItems.reason: Compact list of imminent bookings; every other screen includes the year. Looks intentional; changing it alters a designed summary card.

filedItems.item: Contract charge amounts render raw (`${amount} ${currency}`, no grouping/decimals) in both ContractOperations twins
filedItems.reason: The twins agree with each other; charges are operator-entered and multi-currency (MAD/EUR/USD selectable), so the MAD-locale grouping assumption is weaker. One-line change in both twins if the owner wants it.

filedItems.item: Scheduler library internal timezone helpers hardcode 'en-US' (timezone math, not display)
filedItems.reason: Vendored library internals; display formatting follows the store locale/timezone (browser-local). Touching library math risks scheduler regressions (A2 territory).

filedItems.item: RTL desktop header: language pill grazes the account avatar by ~4px visually (12px box overlap) at 1440 in ar
filedItems.reason: No text clipped, no control hidden or unclickable, absent at 375px and in fr. A spacing fix lives in shared header CSS used by every page — cosmetic, filed rather than redesigning the header inside a consistency slice.

responsiveRtl.headerGraze: In ar at 1440 ONLY, the header language button's box overlaps the account button's box by 12px (language btn l=60..155, account btn l=24..72); visually the avatar (l=32..64) grazes the language pill's background edge by ~4px — the language TEXT (l=111..131) is fully visible, both controls fully clickable, no clipping. fr at 1440: boxes exactly adjacent (1365=1365). responsiveRtl.method: DOM measurements (document scrollWidth vs clientWidth, elements extending past viewport, toolbar button rect overlaps) at 375px and 1440px, fr + ar (dir=rtl confirmed on <html> in ar), for dashboard, bookings, cars, clients, caisse, reports, settings — 28 combinations, harness a4-browser.mjs RESP section.
responsiveRtl.results: NO page-level horizontal overflow in any of the 28 combinations (scrollWidth == clientWidth everywhere). No clipped or hidden controls at 375px in either language. DataGrid screens keep their grid inside its own scroll container (a column-separator/svg extends to 1444/1451px inside the grid's internal scroller at 1440 — not page overflow). One settings switch input reports a negative left at 375 (MUI switch internal input, visually inside its track).
